name: example
about: An organisation whose projects run their recipes with just, land pull requests on GitHub and check a Card line

required.why: the recipes the test scopes run
where jst changes collects the entries

forbidden.instead: the same recipes in the justfile
jst changes new --slug S for each entry

rules: `just gate` is this organisation's gate; `jst test gate` runs it and is what a pull request needs.
`jst land` merges only where `land.autonomy` lets a session merge; otherwise stop at ready for a person.
